text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business which requests for a staff report regarding the feasibility of installing a pedestrian crosswalk at Bellechasse Street and Benshire Drive. Bellechasse Street and Benshire Drive are two busy roads in my ward that intersect directly in front of Bendale Junior Public School. It is very well known to my local residents that motorists often speed through Bellechasse Street and Benshire Drive to access the local school that has over 300 (Gr. JK-06) students. The speeding motorists pose a major safety concern to both the children attending this school and the parents who are dropping their kids off to school. I would like to move the motion below that would create a safer environment for the students, parents, drivers and local residents alike that: Staff report to the July, 2018 Scarborough Community Council with a report…

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to report to the July 4, 2018 meeting of Scarborough Community Council on the feasibility of installing a Pedestrian Crosswalk at Bellechasse Street and Benshire Drive.
